title: Finite coin-run probability as a sum
statement: Let $p=(p_i)_{i\ge 0}$ be a sequence of Boolean bits and let $K\ge 0$. Choose a length-$K$ Boolean word uniformly at random, and scan it against $p$ in order, returning the first bit $p_i$ at a position where the word differs from $p_i$. The probability that this returned bit is true is $\displaystyle\sum_{i=0}^{K-1}\frac{\mathbf 1_{\{p_i=\mathrm{true}\}}}{2^{i+1}}$.
